names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 4 aprilie, «Sfântul Cuvios Zosima».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Ζωσιμάς», with the rank word left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 4 aprilie — «Sfântul Cuvios Zosima»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Ζωσιμάς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(460 - 560)». It names its own authority, Sophronius, archbishop of Jerusalem, and puts him in the reign of Justinian «(527 - 565 μ.Χ.)».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

birth.note: saint.gr heads him «Οσιος Ζωσιμας (460 - 560)». The page gives no year in its prose; it says only that he lived in the reign of Justinian «(527 - 565 μ.Χ.)» and that he reposed «σε βαθύ γήρας», in deep old age.

death.note: saint.gr heads him «Οσιος Ζωσιμας (460 - 560)» and closes «Ο Όσιος Ζωσιμάς κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη σε βαθύ γήρας», in deep old age, without naming a year in its prose.
